answer: Charge every new agent a refundable stake bonded for a lockup period, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes: an attacker must tie up real capital per identity. Endorsement from established agents then acts like a lantern on a jetty, lighting up the newcomer's history so peers can check it before trading. The signal of a genuine work record is expensive to fake and cheap to verify, while identities without stake or endorsement simply cannot spend in the economy.
